exposure: Norepinephrine (6 mcg vs. 5 mcg bolus dose)
outcome: Requirement of rescue doses of norepinephrine
cohort: The study included 80 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: The study found that a 6 mcg bolus dose of norepinephrine was more effective than a 5 mcg dose in preventing spinal-induced hypotension during cesarean section, as evidenced by a lower incidence of hypotension and reduced need for rescue doses.
